content.title: Future-Ready Integration Architecture
content.content:
Airbus Helicopters' integration landscape will look very different in five years. Cloud adoption will accelerate. New production systems will be cloud-native by default. The integration platform selected today must grow with those demands.

- **Hybrid by architecture**: SnapLogic's Ground Plex / Cloud Plex model means the same pipelines, governance model, and operations tooling run on-premises and in cloud simultaneously. When workloads migrate, the integration layer moves with them.

- **Event-driven and streaming-ready**: Beyond batch ETL, SnapLogic supports real-time data streaming and event-driven pipeline triggers. As Airbus Helicopters moves toward real-time production monitoring and predictive maintenance, the same platform handles the streaming tier.

- **Low-code evolution**: Teams that start with guided templates move to advanced pipeline composition over time. Business users who build simple data flows today become integration developers — reducing backlog pressure on central IT.

- **Ecosystem connectivity**: SnapLogic's connector library grows continuously. As new SaaS platforms, cloud services, and industrial IoT systems enter the landscape, connectivity is available without bespoke development.

**Investment case**: A platform selected for on-premises ETL/ELT today can serve as the integration backbone for cloud migration, AI adoption, real-time operations, and self-service analytics over a 5-10 year horizon. That is a significantly better return than a narrower point solution that solves only the immediate RFP scope.
